verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature pages describe Rovo AI as a built-in assistant that can break big ideas into tasks, assign them, and create custom automations, so some work can be handed to it. The evidence is short marketing copy with no detail on an interactive assistant that takes and carries out delegated tasks on its own. Missing for 10: documented assistant/agent interface for delegating arbitrary tasks, depth of autonomous task execution, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Breakdown big ideas into actionable tasks and automatically assign them to the right person with Rovo AI.
Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date - from automated reminders to rules that move work forward.
Rovo AI connects relevant assets and rich data from Confluence, Figma, and your 3rd party apps to your work.
